answer: Auction a fixed number of identity slots each epoch instead of letting anyone mint unlimited names. A beacon publishes the slot count and clearing price, so every newcomer must outbid rivals for one scarce slot and the payment is burned, not refunded. One honest agent needs a single slot for its voyage, while a Sybil operator wanting a thousand fake voices must win a thousand auctions and pay the market price a thousand times. The ivory tower worry that rich actors buy everything is curbed by capping slots per sponsor and rotating unsold slots into the next auction.
